notes: PrismRiot is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Prism Riot (PRIO) with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. It has no transfer fees, administrative powers or external minting functions. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
